name: Amashiro Miki
source:
She was transformed into a futanari by her classmate, the protagonist. She is now living with him in order to have him take responsibility for the incident.
She is a beautiful woman with an attractive face and body and she is popular with both men and women alike. While shy she has a determined personality and in front of the protagonist she has a blunt attitude.

Due to the her futanari transformation her sexual desire is vigorous and sexually she is an extreme masochist.
